subtitle: Out Cebu · Cathay Pacific
overview: Fly Cebu to Shanghai via Hong Kong on Cathay Pacific and stay four nights in 4★ hotels in Shanghai and Wuxi. See the Bund, Chenghuang Temple and Nanjing Road, the Nianhua Bay night view (the “Mini Kyoto of China”), Wuzhen’s East Gate and Xintiandi, with a few shopping stops along the way.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Cebu, Nov 13–17 2026 to Nov 20–24 2026. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.The Bund: Shanghai's riverfront promenade lined with historic buildings, facing the skyscrapers of Pudong.
placeDesc.Oriental Pearl Tower: Shanghai's landmark TV tower with its distinctive spheres, seen on a photo stop from The Bund.
placeDesc.Chenghuang Temple: A Taoist temple in Shanghai's old city, set among traditional-style shops and lanes.
placeDesc.Nanjing Road: Shanghai's famous pedestrian shopping street, busy with stores, restaurants and neon lights.
placeDesc.Nianhua Bay Scenic Spot (Mini Kyoto): A Japanese-style lakeside district in Wuxi lit up at night, nicknamed the Mini Kyoto of China.
placeDesc.Wuzhen East Gate: The main entrance to Wuzhen, a classic Jiangnan water town of canals, stone bridges and old houses.
placeDesc.World’s largest Starbucks Flagship Store: Starbucks' large Reserve Roastery in Shanghai, known for its roasting theatre and design.
placeDesc.LV Mega Ship: A large ship-shaped Louis Vuitton flagship building in Shanghai, visited on this tour.
placeDesc.Xintiandi: A lively Shanghai district of restored stone-gate houses, now filled with cafes and boutiques.
placeDesc.Shikumen: Traditional Shanghai stone-gate lane houses that blend Chinese and Western architecture.
placeDesc.Huaihai Road: One of Shanghai's main shopping streets, where free time is given for shopping.
placeDesc.Huangpu River (optional cruise): An optional river cruise on Shanghai's main river, passing the Bund and Pudong skyline.
